g.title: FigureResolution
g.text: Caption-grounded Figure resolution with a local fast path and quality-gated parsing

g.title: input
g.text: PDF + requested Figure number or caption

g.title: fast
g.text: Exact number and local fast path enabled?

g.title: detector
g.text: find numbered caption + nearby visual region
render locally with page, bounding box, and confidence

g.title: cache
g.text: Accepted parse available in run/persistent cache?

g.title: cascade
g.text: 3. try providers in order; first quality-passing result wins
4. only if every cloud provider fails, use local PyMuPDF

g.title: resolve
g.text: match Figure number or caption, never raw extraction order

g.title: asset
g.text: open preview; retain page, caption, and related tables

g.title: recovery
g.text: read surrounding pages and report the boundary
